messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_2]
Query: Check my 'Fantasy Draft Shortlist' note. I want you to filter that list to only include the drivers who made it to the top Q3 section in this Monaco infographic. Once you have that, draft an email to Marcus Smith with those matching drivers.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to read the 'Fantasy Draft Shortlist' note and filter it down to only the drivers shown in the top Q3 section of the provided Monaco infographic. Then, instruct it to draft an email to Marcus Smith containing this filtered list. If the assistant asks for clarification on which drivers, tell it to use the abbreviations shown in the image. Once the draft is created, move to the next round.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_3]
Query: Actually, delete that email draft, I've changed my mind. I want to filter the list further. Look at this new Bahrain infographic. Find which of those Monaco Q3 drivers ALSO made it to the Q3 section here in Bahrain. Send a text message to Marcus with this final subset of consistent drivers instead.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to delete the email draft you just had it create. Then, ask it to look at the new Bahrain infographic and further filter the previous list of Monaco Q3 drivers, keeping only those who also appear in the top Q3 section of this new image. Instruct it to send a text message to Marcus Smith with this final, intersected list of drivers. If the assistant asks for confirmation before sending, approve it. Proceed once the text is sent.

ROUND 3
Query: I want to keep track of this. Create a new note called 'Consistent Qualifiers' and save this final subset of drivers in it.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a new note titled 'Consistent Qualifiers' and populate it with the final filtered list of drivers that was just texted to Marcus. If the assistant confirms the creation, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_1]
Query: Marcus just texted back and challenged me to a time trial in our racing game. Look at this screen. Create a todo task called 'Beat Spa Record' and put the exact circuit record time shown on the screen in the task description.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to look at the provided racing game screen and create a new todo task named 'Beat Spa Record'. Tell it to extract the circuit record time shown on the screen and put it in the task's description. If the assistant confuses the circuit record with the top lap time, correct it and point it specifically to the 'CIRCUIT RECORD' section. Once the task is created, move to the next round.

ROUND 5
Query: Add a comment to that new task with my current top lap time from the screen, so I know exactly how much time I need to find to beat the record.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to add a comment to the 'Beat Spa Record' task containing your current top lap time, which is visible in the image provided in the previous round. If the assistant asks which time is the top lap time, guide it to look at the 'TOP 3' section for lap number 1. Conclude the conversation once the comment is added.
